subject: Interview day logistics — Jordan Reyes (SWE II) — day-of protocol
content:

Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 22:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interview scheduling + accessibility check for Jordan Reyes (SWE II)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for your time yesterday. We’d like to confirm the panel for your on-site/virtual interview on Thu, Dec 2. The panel will run 9:30–1:00 PT with a 30‑minute lunch buffer. Before we finalize, can you confirm any day‑of accommodations we should arrange? Examples we often provide: ASL interpreter or captioning, quiet room, screen‑reader friendly materials, parking/guest pass if you come onsite.

Proposed schedule (subject to final panel brief):
- 9:30–10:15 — System design (Prio)
- 10:25–11:10 — API internals + runtime (Vivek)
- 11:20–12:00 — Culture + bar raiser

I’ve attached the provisional calendar invite. Please reply with any accessibility needs and your preferred way for us to share materials.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference

Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 01:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling + accessibility check for Jordan Reyes (SWE II)

Thanks, Laura —

Appreciate you sending this over. A few notes: 
- I will need an ASL interpreter for the interview (I sign and will rely on sight language).
- I prefer live captioning as a backup for recorded clips.
- If there’s an onsite option, I’ll need a guest parking permit (I’m traveling from out of town).
- I use a screen‑reader for documents occasionally; please send PDFs with selectable text or a plain text version of any candidate packet.

If you can loop in your interpreter vendor or a contact, that would be great — happy to provide any forms they need.

Best,
Jordan Reyes
(jordan.reyes@gmail.com)

- BlueBridge contact: Maya Carter <maya.carter@bluebridgeasl.com>. They need a brief 15‑minute pre‑call at 9:00 PT to go over names/pronouns and any acronyms.

2) Zoom setup (hosted by Sofia)\- Meeting link: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210\- Passcode: 9rT-2fA\- Please join via the panelist link provided in the calendar invite (speaker ordering already set)\- Interpreter video will be pinned by default; please do not use gallery view as that hides the interpreter for Jordan.

3) Live captions\- Live auto‑captions will be enabled; BlueBridge will also provide a live transcript feed at https://captionhub.bluebridgeasl.com/session/BB-443 (read‑only).

4) Onsite logistics (if Jordan chooses to come in):
- Guest parking permit #: RDW-GST-7729. Valid 8:30–14:00 PT.
- Front desk will hold a printed name badge and escort him to a quiet room by default.

5) Interviewer guidance (short):
- Speak in short phrases, pause often, and avoid speaking over the interpreter.
- Allow ~15 seconds after the interpreter finishes before rephrasing or asking follow-ups.
- Use the panel brief in the Drive link for candidate-specific notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qX_panel_brief_JReyes
